hops.purpose: Maps exposures to standardised-approach exposure classes.

evidence.log: pg_stat_statements · 1 call · CALL etl.sp_load_mart_sa_exposure() · dwh: connected using credentials of sa_engine
evidence.sql:
INSERT INTO public.mart_sa_exposure (
        facility_id, exposure_class, product_code, rating_status, provision_pct,
        on_bal_eur, off_bal_eur, as_of_date)
    SELECT
        e.facility_id,
        CASE e.counterparty_type
            WHEN 'CORP'   THEN 'Corporates'
            WHEN 'RETAIL' THEN 'Retail'
            WHEN 'INST'   THEN 'Institutions'
            WHEN 'SOV'    THEN 'Central governments'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END                 AS exposure_class,
        e.product_code,
        e.rating_status,
        e.provision_pct,
        e.drawn_eur         AS on_bal_eur,
        e.undrawn_eur       AS off_bal_eur,
        e.as_of_date
    FROM public.dw_exposure AS e

hops.purpose: Calculates standardised-approach exposure values with CCF and collateral.

evidence.log: pg_stat_statements · 1 call · CALL etl.sp_calc_sa_exposure() · dwh: connected using credentials of sa_engine
evidence.sql:
INSERT INTO public.calc_sa_exposure (
        facility_id, exposure_class, rating_status,
        orig_on_eur, orig_off_eur, adj_on_eur, adj_off_eur,
        crm_eur, ccf, ev_on_eur, ev_off_eur, as_of_date)
    SELECT
        m.facility_id,
        m.exposure_class,
        m.rating_status,
        m.on_bal_eur                                                     AS orig_on_eur,
        m.off_bal_eur                                                    AS orig_off_eur,
        ROUND(m.on_bal_eur  * (1 - m.provision_pct), 2)                  AS adj_on_eur,
        ROUND(m.off_bal_eur * (1 - m.provision_pct), 2)                  AS adj_off_eur,
        LEAST(COALESCE(a.crm_eur, 0), ROUND(m.on_bal_eur * (1 - m.provision_pct), 2)) AS crm_eur,
        CASE m.product_code WHEN 'COMMIT' THEN 0.939866 ELSE 1.0 END     AS ccf,
        ROUND(m.on_bal_eur * (1 - m.provision_pct), 2)
            - LEAST(COALESCE(a.crm_eur, 0), ROUND(m.on_bal_eur * (1 - m.provision_pct), 2)) AS ev_on_eur,
        ROUND(m.off_bal_eur * (1 - m.provision_pct)
            * CASE m.product_code WHEN 'COMMIT' THEN 0.939866 ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS ev_off_eur,
        m.as_of_date
    FROM fdw_dwh.mart_sa_exposure AS m
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT c.facility_id, SUM(c.allocated_value_eur) AS crm_eur
        FROM fdw_dwh.dw_collateral_alloc AS c
        GROUP BY c.facility_id
    ) AS a
      ON a.facility_id = m.facility_id

evidence.log: pg_stat_statements · 1 call · CALL etl.sp_load_c0700_facts() · sa_engine: connected using credentials of reporting_db
evidence.sql:
INSERT INTO rpt.c0700_facts (template, sheet, row_code, col_code, value, as_of_date)
    WITH g AS (
        SELECT
            c.exposure_class,
            SUM(c.orig_on_eur)  AS orig_on,
            SUM(c.orig_off_eur) AS orig_off,
            SUM(c.adj_on_eur)   AS adj_on,
            SUM(c.adj_off_eur)  AS adj_off,
            SUM(c.ev_on_eur)    AS ev_on,
            SUM(c.ev_off_eur)   AS ev_off,
            SUM(CASE WHEN c.rating_status = 'RATED' THEN c.ev_on_eur  ELSE 0 END) AS ev_on_rated,
            SUM(CASE WHEN c.rating_status = 'RATED' THEN c.ev_off_eur ELSE 0 END) AS ev_off_rated,
            MAX(c.as_of_date)   AS as_of_date
        FROM fdw_sa.calc_sa_exposure AS c
        GROUP BY c.exposure_class
    )
    SELECT 'C 07.00' AS template, g.exposure_class AS sheet, '0010' AS row_code, '0010' AS col_code,
           ROUND((g.orig_on + g.orig_off) / 1000000, 1) AS value, g.as_of_date
    FROM g
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C 07.00' AS template, g.exposure_class AS sheet, '0010' AS row_code, '0040' AS col_code,
           ROUND((g.adj_on + g.adj_off) / 1000000, 1) AS value, g.as_of_date
    FROM g
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'C 07.00' AS template, g.exposure_class AS sheet, '0010' AS row_code, '0200' AS col_code,
           ROUND((g.ev_on + g.ev_off) / 1000000, 1) AS value, g.as_of_date
